response.original_title: How do I shortlist puzzle parking system manufacturers?
response.overview: To shortlist puzzle parking system manufacturers, start by checking their experience in designing and installing parking systems for projects similar to yours. Look for manufacturers that offer different solutions such as a puzzle parking system, hydraulic puzzle parking system, and automated puzzle parking system. Check their previous projects, installation quality, technical team, and ability to customize the system according to your available space and parking requirements. It is also important to compare the technical specifications offered by different puzzle parking system manufacturers. Check the vehicle load capacity, platform size, lifting height, safety features, control system, power requirements, and space utilization. If you are considering a pit puzzle parking system, ask whether the manufacturer has experience with underground installations and can provide a suitable design based on the pit dimensions and site conditions.
